body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Overview”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Mixing seal φ80, set, no material printed. Main-cylinder seal φ80, set. Swing-cylinder seal φ80, set. S-tube small-end seal φ80, set. Swing-arm ball φ80, piece, white or black, upper or lower. Clamp DN80 / 3″ / 89, EN14420-3, PN10/16. Electric 20 delivery pipe inner diameter 80 mm. These seven uses stay on seven pages. φ60 and φ70 are both a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. φ90 is both a swing-cylinder seal and an S-tube small-end seal. φ100 as an S-tube small-end seal is not the pipe cell 100 / 125 mm. Shared piston ODs are listed on the split and integral pages and remain two parts. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“概述”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 搅拌密封 φ80，套，未印材料。主油缸密封 φ80，套。摆缸密封 φ80，套。S 管小端密封 φ80，套。摆臂球头 φ80，个，白或黑，上或下。管卡 DN80 / 3″ / 89，EN14420-3，PN10/16。电动20输送管内径 80 mm。这七处仍在七张页面上。 φ60 和 φ70 同时是摆缸密封和摆臂球头。φ90 同时是摆缸密封和 S 管小端密封。作为 S 管小端密封的 φ100 不是管子格子 100 / 125 mm。两张活塞页上相同的外径仍然是两件配件。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。
